comment: C ref: end.c panic(): wait_synch() waits for a key after "Oops..." before set_error_savefile() and dosave0() run, so a segment that stops at that wait leaves no panic save file. Segment 0: a debug-mode gnomish Healer runs #panic and stops at "Oops...". Segment 1 starts a new game without the panic-save question. Seeds, clocks, character and keys chosen independently.
